decision_summary: v0.6.33 retrospective: QIF moved from calibration description to governed decision consequence without converting consequence into a quality score.
rationale: Visionary: the release closes the gap between probability error and organizational loss boundaries. Builder: extending calibration-report avoided a disconnected package and reused decision-outcome provenance. Guardian: policy-local semantics and source-intent checks were essential because gate-level forecasts could otherwise be falsely presented as intent-specific truth. Additional branch fixtures were added for aligned proceed, aligned defer, false assurance, and false alarm. Remaining limitation: one declared threshold can be brittle and is not yet stress-tested.
recommendation: Carry threshold sensitivity, bounded alternatives, and brittleness governance into v0.6.34; do not optimize or auto-select organizational policy.
